Production viewport isolation is integrated in JavaFxSurfaceProbe/Program. Each logical slot owns a depth-enabled full-canvas SubScene, clipped after rendering. Outer scene composes in parallel projection. Empty inner fill must be null for background pick misses. Perspective inner cameras use default-eye coordinates via an equivalent per-slot Affine; this fixes OpenJFX 21 SceneUtils repeatedly projecting with the inner camera during nested localToScreen. Original mesh/atlas buffers and native pick nodes are retained. Resize/projection/layout/rebuild/disposal are wired; public camera accessor returns actual mounted camera. Snapshot now reuses/restores mounted scene size/AA/fill, or releases a temporary unmounted scene; second simultaneous mount returns typed rejection.
Final evidence: 68 native viewport/snapshot/lifecycle cases; 216 anatomical scale checks; 24 depth-clipping cases; 28 native ray cases; all 4 surfaceViewVisualQaJVM probes; 60 static cortical cases and 86 unlit cortical updates pass (9344 cortical native picks, max strict error4, min IoU0.9999714245, one classified static subpixel pixel). Conformance passes595:132,105,128,128,27,27,25,19,2,2. Examples19JVM+15JS. surfaceViewAdmissionJVM passes48 raster+48 JavaFX legacy cases at3 repetitions; this is NOT new-policy performance or native-ray performance (legacy pick is buffer read). Initial imageJS missing image4s.geometry/cyclic compilation failure cleared on direct compile and full conformance retry without source edits; retain failure in log, no claim of known cause.
